title: Reading what a monster is actually doing
target: How to read the phase a R.E.P.O. monster is in, so the crew reacts to what it is doing rather than simply to the sight of it.
version: R.E.P.O. v0.4.0, as installed for this build (see the sources page for the exact version string)
prerequisites: A monster you have already seen
A way to tell the crew what you are looking at

steps.do: When one appears, wait to see whether it settles into roaming or comes straight for you.
steps.because: spawning and roaming are states of their own (EnemyState)

steps.do: Treat a slower pursuit as the same chase rather than as a reprieve.
steps.because: chasing has its own stages, including a slower pursuit (ChaseSlow)

steps.do: Assume you are being searched for when it goes quiet.
steps.because: investigating and sneaking are separate from chasing (Investigate)

steps.do: Move away from anything a monster could look under.
steps.because: there is a state for looking underneath (LookUnder)

steps.do: Use a stun knowing it is one state among many, not the end of the monster.
steps.because: being stunned sits in the same state list (Stunned)

commonMistakes: Mistaking a slow chase for having lost it.
Hiding under something without checking whether it looks there.
Treating a stun as though it were a kill.
sources: This installation of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
